collectors.name: MONEY
collectors.behavior:
When the round starts, the game moves to a random floor from 1 to 12.
 The DEAD LOVERS free spins has a progressive feature.
 The round starts with full 1x3 WILD symbols present on the screen on reels 1 and 5. They remain on the screen until
 the end of the round and move to different reels at different free spins depending on what is hit during the round.
After every free spin with a win containing the lowest symbol of the current floor, the 1x3 Wild symbols move one reel
 towards each other, first to reels 2 and 4, then meeting in reel 3, where they merge into a single symbol and award 5
more free spins. More wins with the lowest symbol of the current floor splits them again, moving them back to reels 2
 and 4, then to 1 and 5, after which they start to move towards each other again. This moving pattern can happen
 indefinetely until all free spins are played and the round ends.
 After the round ends the game moves back to the floor where it was before free spins started.
 Special reels are in play during this feature.
  HOLD AND SPIN FEATURE
 Whenever the game moves to floor 13 by any means, the HOLD AND SPIN feature is triggered.
 Before the round starts, the game moves to a random floor from 1 to 12.
 These are MONEY symbols. During the HOLD AND SPIN feature only MONEY symbols and blank
 spaces are present on the reels.

 CASH ELEVATOR FEATURE
 The game represents an elevator in a building with 13 floors and a basement.
 On the 1st floor all paying symbols are present on the reel strips.
 Starting from 2nd floor, on every floor, the lowest value symbols are removed from the
 reel strips progressively, leaving only higher value symbols, as follows:
 2nd floor - lowest symbol present is 7th floor - lowest symbol present is
 3rd floor - lowest symbol present is 8th floor - lowest symbol present is
 4th floor - lowest symbol present is 9th floor - lowest symbol present is
 5th floor - lowest symbol present is 10th floor - lowest symbol present is
 6th floor - lowest symbol present is 11th floor - lowest symbol present is

 12th floor - lowest symbol present is
 The game starts on the 3rd floor.
 Whenever a winning combination is awarded with the lowest symbol from that floor, the game goes up by 1 floor.

 These are ARROW symbols.
 They can only land on reel 3.
 Whenever an UP arrow symbol hits, it moves the game by 1, 2, 3 or 12 floors up from the current one.
 Whenever a DOWN arrow symbol hits, it moves the game by 1, 2, or 3 floors down from the current one.
 The current floor is saved for every possible bet and returning to a
 certain bet will move the game to that floor.
 Changing the bet to a level that was never saved before,
 resets the game back to 1st floor.
